result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Contractor defends and indemnifies Company and its affiliates against third-party IP, legal-compliance, Contractor-caused data-security, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims, with notice, defense control, settlement consent, and cooperation procedures. The liability-cap and attorneys’ fee carve-outs make the indemnity effective and leave unrelated terms unchanged. No Customer indemnity is added, which is at least as protective as limiting one to Customer content and legal breaches. Drafting is strong, though the existing section heading remains misleading because it refers to indemnification “of Contractor” rather than indemnification by Contractor.
